Self-contained JS packaging of frozen MPEG-2 WASM binaries. Private and UNLICENSED.
PROVENANCE.json records the additional Blob-graph adaptation and preserves original provenance text.
The following notice is unchanged from the input tree; paths in it refer to that tree.
Its license files are also retained in this package under licenses/.

Private MPEG-2 slice-thread runtime. UNLICENSED; no public distribution authorized.

The mpeg2-rs decoder and facade have no selected public distribution license.
Dependency licenses do not grant a license to that code or to this combined package.

This directory preserves generated wasm-bindgen bindings. The Apache-2.0
wasm-bindgen-rayon worker helper has been modified to forward asynchronous child
initialization rejection to the Worker's error event. Its Google copyright header
is retained. helper-adaptation.json records the original and patched hashes and
the upstream adaptation script identity. This is not an unmodified upstream helper.
Rayon 1.11.0 is MIT OR Apache-2.0; wasm-bindgen-rayon 1.3.0 is Apache-2.0.
PROVENANCE.json identifies all packages in the supplied Cargo lockfile and their
license metadata. licenses/ retains their actual license files, including
third-party notices. This inventory includes build-time dependencies and is not
a claim that all those packages execute in the browser.
